title: Discrete Zero-Pole (with initial states)
text: 指定传递函数的初始状态；按 {Gain} 指定Gain value；{Zeros} 指定 Matrix of zeros、{Poles} 指定 Vector of poles、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定 Interval between samples、{State name} 指定 Unique name for block、{State name must resolve to Simulink signal object} 指定 Require state name resolve to a signal，按实例取值。

params.name: State name
params.values: Unique name for block state '''''''' (default) | alphanumeric string

params.name: State name must resolve to Simulink signal object
params.values: Require state name resolve to a signal object off (default) | on
